title: Mid-Autumn Festival
synopsis: Mid-Autumn Festival is a traditional harvest festival celebrated in China. This is the story of how the Mid-Autumn Festival came to be connected with admiring the moon.

fullText.simplified:
中秋节

    农历八月十五是中国的传统节日——中秋节。那为什么是在八月十五呢？
    很久很久以前，后羿有个非常美丽的妻子叫嫦娥。有一天，后羿得到了两颗长生不老的仙药，但他不舍得吃，就交给嫦娥保管。后羿的徒弟蓬蒙很想得到仙药，所以他趁后羿出门打猎，就逼迫嫦娥交出仙药。嫦娥被逼无奈，情急之下吞下了两颗仙药，然后她感觉到身子越来越轻，慢慢地飘离地面，向天上飞去。因为嫦娥思念丈夫，所以便飞到了离人间最近的月亮上成了仙。后羿回到家后，悲痛欲绝。他仰望夜空，呼唤嫦娥的名字。那天正好是八月十五，月亮又大又圆，而且上面有个身影特别像嫦娥。后羿急忙派人到嫦娥喜欢的花园，在香案上放上她平时爱吃的水果，用来表达对嫦娥的思念。百姓们知道嫦娥奔月成仙后，也纷纷在香案上放上水果，向善良的嫦娥祈求平安。中秋节就这么传开了。
    现在的中秋节，是家人团聚的日子。人们会和家人一起赏月、吃月饼、看花灯。
fullText.traditional:
中秋節

    農曆八月十五是中國的傳統節日——中秋節。那為什麼是在八月十五呢？
    很久很久以前，后羿有個非常美麗的妻子叫嫦娥。有一天，后羿得到了兩顆長生不老的仙藥，但他不捨得吃，就交給嫦娥保管。后羿的徒弟蓬蒙很想得到仙藥，所以他趁后羿出門打獵，就逼迫嫦娥交出仙藥。嫦娥被逼無奈，情急之下吞下了兩顆仙藥，然後她感覺到身子越來越輕，慢慢地飄離地面，向天上飛去。因為嫦娥思念丈夫，所以便飛到了離人間最近的月亮上成了仙。后羿回到家後，悲痛欲絕。他仰望夜空，呼喚嫦娥的名字。那天正好是八月十五，月亮又大又圓，而且上面有個身影特別像嫦娥。后羿急忙派人到嫦娥喜歡的花園，在香案上放上她平時愛吃的水果，用來表達對嫦娥的思念。百姓們知道嫦娥奔月成仙後，也紛紛在香案上放上水果，向善良的嫦娥祈求平安。中秋節就這麼傳開了。
    現在的中秋節，是家人團聚的日子。人們會和家人一起賞月、吃月餅、看花燈。

raw.synopsis: Mid-Autumn Festival is a traditional harvest festival celebrated in China. This is the story of how the Mid-Autumn Festival came to be connected with admiring the moon.
sentence_translations: Mid-Autumn Festival
The 15th day of the 8th month of the lunar calendar is a Chinese traditional holiday - the Mid-Autumn Festival.
But why is the 15th day of the 8th month?
A long long time ago, Houyi had an extremely beautiful wife called Chang'e.
One day, Houyi obtained two immortality potions but was unwilling to eat them, so he gave them to Chang'e to safekeep.
Houyi's apprentice Peng Meng really wanted to get his hands on the immortality potions, ..
.. so he took his chance when Houyi was out hunting and forced Chang'e to hand him the potions.
Chang'e was unable to fight back, and in a moment of desperation she swallowed down the two potions.
She then felt that her body got lighter and lighter, and slowly floated away from the ground, flying up into the skies.
Because Chang'e missed her husband, she flew to the moon, closest to the human world, and became an immortal.
After Houyi returned home, he grieved inconsolably.
He looked up at the night sky and yelled Chang'e's name
That day was the 15th day of the 8th month and the moon was both big and round, ..
.. and on it was a silhouette that looked exactly like Chang'e.
Houyi hurriedly sent a person to Chang'e's beloved garden to place her favorite fruits on the incense table, ..
.. in order to express his longing for Chang'e.
After the common people learned that Chang'e had headed to the moon and become an immortal, ..
.. one after another they too would place fruit on the incense table and pray for the kindhearted Chang'e's wellbeing.
This is how the Mid-Autumn Festival started.
Nowadays Mid-Autumn Festival is a day of family reunion.
Together with family, people admire the full moon, eat mooncake and watch the colored lanterns.
